getformo-cli-formo-analytics.description: Query and manage Formo product analytics and onchain wallet data through the Formo MCP server, @formo/cli, or public REST API. Use when an agent needs to inspect KPIs, events, funnels, retention, revenue, users, wallet profiles, contracts, segments, boards, charts, or alerts; run SQL against a Formo project; ingest analytics events; search Formo documentation; or configure Formo access for an AI client.
